text:
maria.l: quick sync — post-launch follow-ups for Iteration 1. we shipped the streaming fallback last week; seeing a few customer reports and a diff in latency at p95. need to decide bug vs enhancement prioritization for next sprint. who wants to kick off?
aj: what are the concrete signals? is this customer-impacting (errors/crashes) or perf/regression?
maria.l: mostly perf at p95 for longer contexts, one reported incorrect merge of tool calls (customer A). no crashes. overall NPS for the flow is stable but CS escalations for two customers.
devon: customer A's issue looks like a prompt-parsing edge case — reproducible with their prompt. low frequency but high business value (payment flow).
soph: we should quantify: # of requests affected, revenue at risk, and rollback cost. my quick numbers: customer A ~0.3% of requests, but 12% of payments in that flow.
ben: suggestion: triage into 3 lanes — P0 bug (customer A tool merge), P1 perf regressions for high-traffic paths, P2 usability/enhancements and polish. allocate 40% of next sprint to P0+P1.
aj: +1 to lanes. can we do a 2-day hotfix for the tool merge and run a canary for ~48h? if it fixes, promote.
maria.l: agree. also want to avoid starving roadmap. we still have the follow-on milestone to add cached prefix support (reduces cost by ~15%).
soph: tradeoff: cached prefix would reduce unit cost and p50, but not solve customer A. I'd prioritize hotfix + perf investigation, then a short spike for prefix cache.
devon: timeline: I can do hotfix PR today, test harness with the customer's prompt case, and we can ship a canary by EOD tomorrow. Ben — can you reserve the canary pool (dedicated) and set routing?
ben: reserving a small canary capacity. will add a routing rule and TTL=2h so we can ramp. also will add an alert if error-rate > 0.5% or latency p95 increases > 20%.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: devon/hotfix-tool-merge -> canary (1 replica). ETA: +20h. status will update in thread. :gear:
aj: for perf regressions we should add a short benchmark triage: compare pre-launch vs current for 3 representative workloads (short chat, long context streaming, embeddings). I can own benchmarks this week.
maria.l: thanks. next: backlog grooming — move lower-impact UX tweaks to the following sprint and keep room for hotfix and cache spike. propose grooming session tomorrow 10:30am PT, 30m.
soph: I'll prep impact numbers for the UX items and surface any customer asks.
devon: will post the repro steps + failing test case in #eng-runtime so QA can run it.
ben: also propose a tiny definition of 'blocked vs needs-investigation': blocked = customer-facing failure for payment flow or data-loss; needs-investigation = perf/regression or intermittent incorrect outputs. helps prioritize triage.
maria.l: good definition. final asks: aj run the benchmark, devon ship canary, ben monitor, soph prepare groom notes. we'll re-evaluate after canary run (~48h). if canary ok, we promote; if not, we rollback and escalate. thanks all :raised_hands:
